promises.quote: The Trust have a monthly joined Emergency Medicine and Surgical teaching session. This is a platform for these Departments to present and discuss cases they face in order to improve patient safety continuously. It is important to note that cases surrounding acute abdomen are frequent and therefore often require discussion of the AAPP. The AAPP is a feature of these discussions each time a relevant case is discussed.
promises.summary: Monthly Emergency Medicine and Surgical teaching sessions to discuss AAPP cases and improve staff knowledge.
